title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out with Grass Wonder…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Trainer, look at all of those Umamusume plushies. They seem to be prizes for that claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm curious which racers there are. Though it does seem rather noisy inside…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder is clearly interested, but the shop's atmosphere is making her a little uncomfortable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's hard to see much of anything from here. I wonder if there's a plushie of Spe or El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Just watching from the sidelines wouldn't feel right. If only there were a way I could help you, then it would be like a joint effort.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That sounds like it would help. Very well, I'll be your voice of support.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll give it my all. Go, go, Trainer! Go, go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
